resources.string: In Developer options › Wireless debugging, tap \"Pair device with pairing code\" and keep that dialog open.
Type the six-digit code from the dialog here. Keep the dialog open until this finishes.
Paired. Switching At a Glance to this app…
At a Glance is now served by this app. The launcher and SystemUI restarted.
Pairing worked, but activation did not. %1$s Then open the app and tap Activate.
The code must be six digits.
Wrong pairing code. Start pairing again.
The pairing dialog was closed before the code was sent.
The phone rejected the pairing. Start again.
Waiting for Wi-Fi to re-activate At a Glance
